facts.heading: Divorce after fifteen years of marriage
facts.content: Jana and her husband Radko decided on a divorce after fifteen years of marriage.
facts.evidence: After fifteen years of marriage, my husband Radko and I decided on a divorce.

facts.heading: Divorce conversation in September
facts.content: Radko told Jana in September that their marriage couldn't go on.
facts.evidence: And in September he told me that it couldn't go on like this.

facts.heading: Jana's emotional state during news
facts.content: Jana experienced feelings of emptiness and anger alternating several times a day.
facts.evidence: Emptiness. And then anger. Then emptiness again.

facts.heading: Husband's reason for divorce
facts.content: Radko stated that they drifted apart and live next to each other.
facts.evidence: He says that we drifted apart. That we live next to each other.

facts.heading: Jana's self-blame regarding marriage
facts.content: Jana feels she should have noticed the drifting apart and is looking for where she made a mistake.
facts.evidence: I keep going over it in my head and looking for where I made a mistake.

facts.heading: Jana's uncertainty about her role
facts.content: Jana sometimes thinks she was too tired and didn't care about Radko, other times she cared too much.
facts.evidence: Sometimes I think I was too tired and didn't care about him, other times that I cared too much.

facts.heading: Children's names and ages
facts.content: Jana has two children: Anička, who is twelve, and Matěj, who is eight years old.
facts.evidence: Anička is twelve and Matěj is eight years old.

facts.heading: Delay in telling children about divorce
facts.content: Jana and Radko are postponing telling the children about the divorce.
facts.evidence: Radek wants us to tell them together, but we keep putting it off.

facts.heading: Anička suspects fighting
facts.content: Anička asked Jana if Dad and she were fighting last week.
facts.evidence: Last week she asked me if Dad and I are fighting.

facts.heading: Jana lied to Anička
facts.content: Jana lied to Anička when she asked if her parents were fighting.
facts.evidence: Because I lied.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of telling children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of Anička's tears when telling her the truth.
facts.evidence: But I'm afraid of her tears.

facts.heading: Housing arrangement details
facts.content: The apartment is on a mortgage, and Radko is probably moving in with his brother.
facts.evidence: The apartment is on a mortgage. Radek is probably moving in with his brother, at least for now.

facts.heading: Children will stay with Jana
facts.content: Jana will be the one who the children stay with.
facts.evidence: The children will stay with me.

facts.heading: Jana's fear of managing alone
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't manage the situation alone because Radko always dealt with money.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't manage it alone. Radek always dealt with money.

facts.heading: Job as Czech teacher in Brno
facts.content: Jana works as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. She teaches nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.
facts.evidence: I work as a Czech teacher at an elementary school in Brno. I teach nine-year-olds and eight-year-olds.

facts.heading: Feeling of life falling apart
facts.content: Jana feels that everyone sees that her life is falling apart.
facts.evidence: I have the feeling that everyone sees that my life is falling apart.

facts.heading: Principal knows about distress
facts.content: Only the principal at the school knows about Jana's situation.
facts.evidence: Only the principal. I told her because I once cried in the hallway.

facts.heading: Principal allowed early leave
facts.content: The principal allowed Jana to leave early, giving her an hour off.
facts.evidence: That she let me leave early. She gave me an hour off.

facts.heading: Worse when alone at home
facts.content: Jana felt worse when she was alone at home compared to being at work.
facts.evidence: But then I sat at home and it was worse.

facts.heading: Sleep pattern at night
facts.content: Jana wakes up at three in the morning every night and thinks about the future.
facts.evidence: Every night I wake up at three in the morning and think about what will happen next.

facts.heading: Worries about finances and children
facts.content: Jana worries about not having a mortgage, not having a husband, and how she will tell the children about finances.
facts.evidence: That I don't have a mortgage, I don't have a husband, I don't have anything. Then I calculate the money, then I imagine how I will tell the children.

facts.heading: Sleep duration and fatigue
facts.content: Jana falls asleep around five and wakes up at half past seven, feeling tired in the morning.
facts.evidence: I fall asleep around five, and I wake up at half past seven. I am tired already in the morning.

facts.heading: Weight loss and friend's comment
facts.content: Jana has lost four kilos and a friend told her she looks terrible.
facts.evidence: I lost four kilos. A friend says I look terrible.

facts.heading: Support system includes sister and friend
facts.content: Jana has her sister Alena in Olomouc, who calls her almost every evening, and a friend Eva from work.
facts.evidence: I have my sister Alena in Olomouc. She calls me almost every evening. And a friend Eva from work.

facts.heading: Sharing details with sister and friend
facts.content: Jana tells Alena almost everything, but only tells Eva that she is having a difficult period.
facts.evidence: Alena almost everything. Eva only that I am having a difficult period.

facts.heading: Fear of perceived failure
facts.content: Jana fears that she has failed and that a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.
facts.evidence: That I have failed. That a woman who cannot maintain a marriage is not a good example for children.

facts.heading: Belief from mother about marriage
facts.content: Jana believes marriage lasts no matter what, a belief she attributes to her mother.
facts.evidence: Probably from my mom. She always said that marriage lasts no matter what.

facts.heading: Mother's reaction to Jana
facts.content: Jana's mother was silent after Jana told her, then said she hoped Jana had thought it through properly.
facts.evidence: She was silent. Then she said that she hoped I had thought it through properly.

facts.heading: Desire for comfort from mother
facts.content: Jana wishes her mother would hug her and does not want to be alone.
facts.evidence: I would like her to hug me. That I don't want to be alone.

facts.heading: Family norm regarding expression
facts.content: Jana feels that expressing feelings like hurt or not wanting to be alone is not done in her family.
facts.evidence: But that's not done in our family.

facts.heading: Crying when expressing feelings
facts.content: When Jana says her feelings out loud, she cries and apologizes.
facts.evidence: I cry. I apologize.

facts.heading: Need for sleep and clarity
facts.content: Jana feels that sleep and knowing how to tell the children are what would help her most right now.
facts.evidence: Sleep. And knowing how to tell the children.

facts.heading: Tried chamomile tea for sleep
facts.content: Jana has tried chamomile tea for sleep.
facts.evidence: Chamomile tea, and that's it

facts.heading: Refuses doctor's sleep pills
facts.content: Jana does not want to take the pills the doctor offered.
facts.evidence: I don't want them

facts.heading: Fear of missing children's wake-up
facts.content: Jana is afraid she won't be able to wake up in time for the children.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I won't be able to wake up in time for the children

facts.heading: Fear of dependency
facts.content: Jana does not want to be dependent on medication.
facts.evidence: And I don't want to be dependent

facts.heading: Agrees to note sleep triggers
facts.content: Jana is willing to try writing down what wakes her up.
facts.evidence: I could

facts.heading: Fear of panicking for children
facts.content: Jana is afraid she will panic and cry around the children.
facts.evidence: That I'll panic and cry

facts.heading: Fear of crying in front of children
facts.content: Jana is afraid of crying in front of the children because it would be terrifying for them.
facts.evidence: That I would cry in front of the children? After all, it would be terrifying for them

facts.heading: Anička is sensitive
facts.content: Jana believes Anička is sensitive.
facts.evidence: Anička is sensitive

facts.heading: Feels not alone, not needing to manage
facts.content: Jana feels that she is not alone and does not have to manage things right away.
facts.evidence: That I am not alone and that I don't have to manage it right away
